title: test: seven suites keep their temp databases and scaffolds off the shard's shared disk (memory-backed TMPDIR)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CXc5hequf76uJfzrdK
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgKURKuRGF1ewEVVZKx7U1i4)_
Fixes #27306

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：create-objectstack、cli、runtime、driver-turso、driver-sql、service-package、service-automation 七个包的测试配置，把测试临时目录（TMPDIR）指到内存盘 /dev/shm；新增共享助手 `scripts/vitest-memory-tmp.mjs`（附 `.d.mts` 类型声明），driver-sqlite-wasm 也改读它。不动任何产品代码、用例、断言或超时。
- 为什么改：这些测试把 SQLite 库或脚手架目录写在系统临时目录里，CI 分片上磁盘被邻居测试占满时，fsync 和删目录要排队，用例或收尾钩子就超时；main 上两次 `Test Core (5/8)` 红灯落在 create-objectstack。
- 风险与回滚：只影响测试进程的临时目录；没有可写 /dev/shm 的机器（macOS、Windows）照旧用系统临时目录。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`scripts/vitest-memory-tmp.mjs`（理由与开关）、`packages/create-objectstack/vitest.config.ts`（与 main 红灯同形的那一包）、`packages/cli/vitest.config.ts`（两个 project 各自带 env）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter create-objectstack test`，应 19 个文件全绿；在 4 个 `dd conv=fsync` 写入者旁跑同一命令，改前 2 个文件因 afterAll 超时失败，改后全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`scripts/vitest-memory-tmp.mjs`** + **`scripts/vitest-memory-tmp.d.mts`** (new, the tsup-drop-sources-content.mjs shape; round 2 moved it there from a root `.mts`, which `tsconfig.test.json` refuses as TS5097): `memoryBackedTmpEnv()` returns `{ TMPDIR: '/dev/shm' }` when `/dev/shm` is writable and `{}` otherwise. It holds the rationale once. It is deliberately not a key of the shared preset, which every re-exporter inherits.
- **Seven configs spread it into `test.env`**: `create-objectstack`, `cli`, `runtime`, `driver-turso`, `driver-sql`, `service-package` and `service-automation`. `cli` and `runtime` declare vitest `projects`, where a root-level `env` is inert, so each project's own `env` carries it beside `OS_REGISTRY_LOG`. `driver-turso` re-exported the preset, so it now restates the preset's one setting in its own config, the shape `driver-sqlite-wasm` took in #27245.
- **`driver-sqlite-wasm`** (the #27245 precedent) now reads the same helper instead of its private copy. Its behaviour is unchanged.
- Each config records its own before and after reading in a comment.

No product source changed. No case, assertion, fixture, timeout or budget changed, and no retry was added (the #27076 ruling).

## Why

`os.tmpdir()` reads `TMPDIR`, and a child process inherits it. Every database file and scaffold tree these suites write was measured to sit under `os.tmpdir()` (the card asked for this reading per package). So the one setting moves all of it off the runner's shared disk. On a Test Core shard, a case that fsyncs, or a hook that unlinks a tree, waits for the other suites' I/O, so its wall time measures the neighbours rather than the code.

**create-objectstack, stated in three parts, as the seat asked:**

1. **The failing case in main's two reds is NOT MEASURED.** Push CI runs 40713919581 and 40718500281 (`Test Core (5/8)`) annotate only `packages/create-objectstack … pnpm run test exited (1)`. Their full job logs and artifacts are served from a storage host that this cloud container's egress proxy refuses (403). The log API returns only the last 5,000 lines, and the failing segment sits near line 33,848 of 42,326.
2. **The local signature matches, but it is not proven to be the same failure.** Beside four `dd conv=fsync` writers, all 301 cases passed while two FILES failed with `Hook timed out in 10000ms`. The timeouts were in the `afterAll` that removes the scaffolded tree (`created-summary.test.ts:134`, `scaffold-skills-single-copy.test.ts:289`). That gives a red package with no failed test named, which is the shape of the annotation.
3. **The mechanism is metadata disk load, not fsync.** `strace -f -c` over the whole suite counted 4 fsync, 4,018 unlink and 6,202 rmdir calls. The scaffolds' creation and removal is what waits on the loaded disk. The same isolation fixes it, because every path is under `os.tmpdir()`.

For the other packages, the mechanism is SQLite durability I/O. Under strace, one `cli` file (`organization-ownership-apply.generation-1.test.ts`) made 3,388 fsync calls. One `runtime` file (`package-revert-stored-members.integration.test.ts`) made 784 fsync and 982 unlink calls, the second being SQLite's per-transaction journal deletes.

## Tests

Each package was measured three ways on the same files: idle on the base, beside four `dd if=/dev/zero bs=1M count=256 conv=fsync` writers on the same disk on the base, and beside the same writers on the head. All runs were on tree `objectstack@6d7634a9` (base) and this branch (head), in a 4 vCPU cloud container with `/` on `/dev/vda` and `/dev/shm` on tmpfs, using `vitest run --maxWorkers=2`. Four synthetic writers are a stress, not a replay of a shard, so a red here means "exposed", not "will go red". The absolute seconds are shared-box readings.

| Package (files measured) | Idle, base | Under load, base | Under load, head |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `create-objectstack` (all 19) | 19/19 files, 21 s | **2/19 files fail** (afterAll hook timeouts, 0/301 cases), 236 s | 19/19 files, 20 s |
| `cli` (the 15 `organization-ownership-*` files) | 232/232, 68 s | **145/232 cases time out**, 7 files, 1,809 s | 232/232, 59 s |
| `runtime` (51 files using SQLite under `os.tmpdir()`) | 684/684, 102 s | **25/684 time out**, 7 files (package revert, uninstall, duplicate-adopt, list-commits, audit-meta-item), 501 s | 684/684, 110 s |
| `driver-turso` (14 files using `os.tmpdir()`) | 502/502, 17 s | **21/502 time out**, 4 files (inherited-members, external-object-parity, drift-detection, migration-entries), 211 s | 502/502, 17 s |
| `driver-sql` (23 files using `os.tmpdir()`) | 192/192, 28 s | **3/192 time out** (posture conformance, reclaim-space, declared-index retired keys), 98 s | 192/192, 28 s |
| `service-package` (2 files) | 11/11, slowest case 0.17 s | 11/11 green, slowest case **3.04 s** | 11/11, slowest case 0.15 s |
| `service-automation` (4 files) | 86/86, slowest case 0.31 s | 86/86 green, slowest case **4.35 s** of its 5 s budget | 86/86, slowest case 0.34 s |

Every failure under load on the base is `Test timed out` or `Hook timed out`. None is an assertion failure, and none fails idle. `service-package` and `service-automation` stayed green in this load run (the card's survey had 5 of 11 and 1 of 8 failing). They are treated because the card lists them as exposed and the readings put them at 61% and 87% of budget for no change in code.

Full package suites on the head: each affected package's own suite, idle, on the final head `110f05aa` (after merging `origin/main`), unless noted:

- `cli` unit layer (`vitest run --project unit`): 346/346 files, 5,032/5,032 tests. The integration layer is CI's; its 14 measured `organization-ownership-*` integration files are in the table above.
- `runtime` (`pnpm test`): 471 files, 7,668 passed and 19 skipped.
- On `fb2d18d7`, before the merge of `main`, which touched no file of these five: `driver-turso` 95 files, 2,492 passed and 34 skipped; `driver-sql` 236 files passed and 12 skipped, 3,847 tests passed and 214 skipped; `service-package` 10/10 files, 127/127; `service-automation` 217/217 files, 2,768/2,768; `create-objectstack` 19/19 files, 301/301; `driver-sqlite-wasm` 39/39 files, 746/746.

## Acceptance notes

- `service-print` (the card's Chromium-profile exception) and the other fsyncing packages in the card's survey (`dogfood`, `plugin-auth`, `verify`, `service-datasource`, `plugin-security`, `plugin-pinyin-search`, `rest`) are not touched. The card's own table measured the last four of those green under load, and `dogfood`, `verify` and `rest` were not in its exposure table.
- Some `cli` tests deliberately scaffold under `packages/cli/node_modules/…` or `packages/cli/tmp` (they need the workspace's module resolution) and are not moved by `TMPDIR`. They were not in the measured failing family, and this PR leaves them alone.
- The survey's evidence file (`pm-orders/server/evidence/27076/fsync-survey.md`) was not reachable from this account, so every reading above was re-measured here.
- No changeset: the diff touches only vitest configs and a root test helper, none of which is in any package's published `files`. `Check Changeset` reports whatever it reports, and the seat decides on the label.

## Verification

All on the final head `110f05aa`.

<details><summary>Derived gate families: 45 derived, 45 run, all exit 0</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 45 families from the 9 changed paths. Each was run and its exit code recorded, then reconciled with `--ran`: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 45 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 45 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. Two notes. `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 on a shallow clone (its pinned fixture commit was unreachable) and exited 0 after `git fetch --unshallow`. `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` read built output, so they were run after a full `turbo run build`.

</details>

<details><summary>Lint</summary>

`eslint --no-inline-config` over the nine touched files: exit 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

</details>

<details><summary>How the load was made</summary>

Four loops of `dd if=/dev/zero of=FILE bs=1M count=256 conv=fsync` on the same disk as `/tmp`, started 3 s before the suite and stopped after it. Each base/head pair used the same file list and `--maxWorkers=2`. The per-file and per-case durations come from vitest's JSON reporter.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint on the nine touched files, exit 0; the repo-wide run is CI's)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [ ] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. (the local subset is above; the full farm is CI's)
